title: Agent Lord sanitized handoff packet v1
description: Authored by the source session from its own visible context only. Never a transcript, provider log, or hidden reasoning. The control plane validates this shape with bounds of 64 KiB canonical bytes, 8 KiB per string, and 64 items per list, verifies integrity.sha256 over the canonical packet without its integrity field, and rejects high-confidence secret patterns.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp declared by the source session

opaque_id.description: caller-declared only; the control plane records identity_assurance and never claims it is verified

task_id.description: must equal the handoff command's --task-id; a mismatch fails closed

task.description: the user-authorized continuation task, stated concretely

workspace_writes.description: must equal NOT --read-only; a mismatch fails closed

external_writes.description: prompt-enforced boundary; there is no third provider permission posture

suggested_skills.description: skills that materially help the fresh continuation endpoint

path.description: workspace-relative; absolute paths and .. segments are rejected

contract_request.description: requested execution contract; explicit command arguments must match or the handoff fails closed

sanitization.description: source-session attestation; required even though the control plane also scans for high-confidence secret patterns

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical UTF-8 packet (sorted keys, compact separators, trailing LF) without the integrity field
